# Creating an {{ ibm_power_server_title }} workspace {#creating-ibm-power-vs-workspace}

To host your OpenShift Container Platform cluster on {{ ibm_power_server_name }}, you can create a dedicated workspace and retrieve its identifier for use during installation.
